overview: A comprehensive pepper farm management app for tracking income, expenses, inventory, customers, sales, worker attendance, farm time, departmental reporting, and harvest logging. Built for a small Nigerian pepper farm with admin controls, user verification, and structured weekly departmental reports.
features: Income & expense bookkeeping in Nigerian Naira (₦)
Worker attendance register with summary cards
Farm time logging with backend persistence
Departmental weekly reporting (4 leads: Goodnews, Nicholas, Elvis, Wisdom)
Admin roles with deletion key security (2642)
Monthly plot expansion tracker (2 plots/month goal)
Department performance metrics and compliance badges
Income vs expenses trend charts and CSV export
